title: Document collaboration
idea: Document collaboration: The document remains central while comments attach to stable anchors and change summaries preserve context.
audience: People who need to review document within a product-web surface.
worksWellWhen: People need to discuss exact content rather than general messages.
avoidWhen: Annotations cannot reliably attach to the current document version.
distinctFrom: Differs from a generic document layout through its review document priority and explicit commitment contract: Changes and comments report their actual save/version status before success.
navigation: Document collaboration keeps the current review document context visible; secondary detail has an explicit return path.

composition.entry: The document remains central while comments attach to stable anchors and change summaries preserve context.
composition.continuation: Continue with the evidence and controls needed to review document; people need to discuss exact content rather than general messages.
composition.priority: Changes and comments report their actual save/version status before success.

imagery.role: Support the actual review document context; essential controls and state remain native.

brandConstraints: Preserve approved identity, semantic roles and licensed assets.
Treat font and palette suggestions as optional; do not replace fixed branding.
responsiveRules: Open comments in a separate pane or sheet with an explicit return anchor.
Preserve entered data and focus when responsive panels become routes.

stateContracts.loading: Keep the document collaboration structure stable while authoritative content resolves; expose unavailable action state.
stateContracts.empty: Explain why no review document content is available and offer a relevant next action.
stateContracts.failure: Preserve safe context and identify the failed operation; Changes and comments report their actual save/version status before success.
stateContracts.offline: Label cached/unsynchronized review document content and prevent claims of server completion.
stateContracts.success: Changes and comments report their actual save/version status before success.
stateContracts.interruption: Restore the active review document context safely after navigation, focus loss or platform interruption; do not replay committed actions.

accessibilityRisks: Do not communicate state through color alone; name controls and expose current selection.
Verify reading order, input alternatives, enlarged text and focus restoration for this composition.

performanceBudget.principle: Set an explicit project budget from the actual content/device; no unsupported universal frame or bundle promise.
performanceBudget.verify: Measure task interaction latency with representative data and slow network states.

reviewNotes: Original authored candidate; no representative render, independent craft review or task evaluation is attached. Structural validation is not visual validation.
